<div class="hero-quote" markdown>
**"Open Science is the movement to make scientific research (including publications, data, physical samples, and software) and its dissemination accessible to all levels of society, amateur or professional..."** [(Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_science){target=_blank}
</div>

This Awesome List is compiled in the effort to help new researchers find and learn about Open Science Tools.

### Open Science FAQ

??? Question "What is Open Science?"

    [Wikipedia definition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_science){target=_blank} - comprehensive overview of open science principles

    [UNESCO Recommendation on Open Science](https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000379949.locale=en){target=_blank} - international framework for open science policy

     - [UNESCO Open Science](https://www.unesco.org/en/open-science){target=_blank} - UNESCO's open science initiative and resources

    [Open Science Manifesto](https://ocsdnet.org/manifesto/open-science-manifesto/){target=_blank} - principles for democratizing knowledge globally

    ??? "Six Pillars :material-pillar: of Open Science"

        **:material-pillar: Open methodology**

        **:material-pillar: Open Source Software**

        **:material-pillar: Open Data**

        **:material-pillar: Open Access**

        **:material-pillar: Open Peer Review**

        **:material-pillar: Open Educational Resources**

??? Question "How do you define reproducible science?"

    ??? "Reproducibility and Replicability in Science by The National Academies 2019"

        [National Academies Report 2019](https://www.nationalacademies.org/projects/DBASSE-BBCSS-17-03){target=_blank} - consensus study on reproducibility in science

        **Reproducibility** means computational reproducibility—obtaining consistent computational results using the same input data, computational steps, methods, code, and conditions of analysis.

        **Replicability** means obtaining consistent results across studies aimed at answering the same scientific question, each of which has obtained its own data.

    ??? "Reproducibility vs Replicability by Plesser (2018)"

        In [Reproducibility vs. Replicability](https://doi.org/10.3389%2Ffninf.2017.00076){target=_blank}, Hans Plesser gives the following useful definitions:

        **Repeatability** (Same team, same experimental setup): The measurement can be obtained with stated precision by the same team using the same measurement procedure, the same measuring system, under the same operating conditions, in the same location on multiple trials. For computational experiments, this means that a researcher can reliably repeat her own computation.

        **Replicability** (Different team, same experimental setup): The measurement can be obtained with stated precision by a different team using the same measurement procedure, the same measuring system, under the same operating conditions, in the same or a different location on multiple trials. For computational experiments, this means that an independent group can obtain the same result using the author's own artifacts.

        **Reproducibility** (Different team, different experimental setup): The measurement can be obtained with stated precision by a different team, a different measuring system, in a different location on multiple trials. For computational experiments, this means that an independent group can obtain the same result using artifacts which they develop completely independently.

        The paper goes on to further simplify:

        **Methods reproducibility**: provide sufficient detail about procedures and data so that the same procedures could be exactly repeated.

        **Results reproducibility**: obtain the same results from an independent study with procedures as closely matched to the original study as possible.

        **Inferential reproducibility**: draw the same conclusions from either an independent replication of a study or a reanalysis of the original study.

??? Question "How many pillars :material-pillar: of Open Science Are There?"

    Depending on what you find, the number generally ranges from 4 to 8

    - [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_science){target=_blank} - overview of open science pillars

    - [4 Pillars :material-pillar:](https://narratives.insidehighered.com/four-pillars-of-open-science/){target=_blank} - Inside Higher Ed framework

    - [8 Pillars :material-pillar:](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/library/open-science-research-support/open-science/8-pillars-open-science){target=_blank} - UCL Library comprehensive framework

    ??? Idea "Commonly Identified Pillars :material-pillar:"

          **:material-pillar: Data**

          FAIR Principles

          CARE Principles

          **:material-pillar: Code**

          **:material-pillar: Publications**

          **:material-pillar: Reviews**

          **:material-pillar: Education**

??? Question "What is Cloud Native Science?"

    [Abernathey et al. (2021)](https://doi.org/10.1109/MCSE.2021.3059437){target=_blank} propose three pillars of cloud native science

    ??? "Three Pillars :material-pillar: of Cloud Native Science"

        **:material-pillar: Analysis-Ready Data (ARD)**

          also Analyisis Ready Cloud Optimized (ARCO) formats, e.g., [Cloud Optimized GeoTiff](https://cogeo.org){target=_blank}

        **:material-pillar: Data-proximate Computing**

          also called server-side computing, allowing computations to happen remotely

        **:material-pillar: Scalable Distributed Computing**

          the ability to modify the volume and number of resources used in a computational process.

### Diagrams

``` mermaid
flowchart LR

id1([open science]) --> id3([open publishing]) & id4([open data]) & id5([open tools])

id3([open publishing]) --> id41([open access]) & id42([open reviews])

id5([open tools]) --> id8([open repositories]) & id10([open services]) & id11([open workflows])

id8([open repositories]) --> id12([version control]) & id13([container registries])

id12([version control]) --> id101([compute])

id13([container registries]) --> id101([compute])

id14([public data registry]) --> id101([compute])

id10([open services]) --> id101([compute])

id11([open workflows]) --> id101([compute])

id4([open data]) --> id14([public data registry])

id101([compute]) <--> id15([on-prem]) & id16([commercial cloud]) & id17([public cloud])

id15([On-Prem]) <--> id20([open resources])

id16([Commercial Cloud]) <--> id20([open resources])

id17([Public Clouds]) <--> id20([open resources])
```

## :fontawesome-solid-globe: Global

[UNESCO](https://www.unesco.org/en/open-science){target=_blank} - Recommendation on Open Science provides an international framework for open science policy and practice that recognizes disciplinary and regional differences in open science perspectives

## :fontawesome-solid-earth-americas: Americas

### :fontawesome-solid-earth-americas: Canada

[Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC)](https://nserc-crsng.canada.ca/en){target=_blank} - Canada's federal research funding agency

### :fontawesome-solid-earth-americas: Mexico

[CONAHCYT (formerly CONACYT)](https://conahcyt.mx/){target=_blank} - Mexico's science and technology council, elevated to Secretariat level in 2025

[UC-MEXUS](https://ucmexus.ucr.edu/funding/grant_collaborative.html){target=_blank} - University of California Institute for Mexico-US collaborative research

[Ciencia abierta](https://doi.org/10.30878/ces.v30n1a11){target=_blank} - open science policy in Latin America

[AACR MONARCA Grant](https://www.aacr.org/grants/aacr-monarca-grant-latin-america/){target=_blank} - cancer research grants for Latin America researchers

[National Science Foundation (NSF)](https://www.nsf.gov/){target=_blank} - US federal agency funding fundamental research

[National Institutes of Health (NIH)](https://www.nih.gov/grants-funding){target=_blank} - largest public funder of biomedical research

[Department of Energy (DoE)](https://www.energy.gov/science/office-science){target=_blank} - funds physical sciences and energy research

[National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA)](https://science.nasa.gov/researchers/sara/grant-solicitations){target=_blank} - NASA research funding opportunities through ROSES

[National Institute of Food and Agriculture (NIFA)](https://www.nifa.usda.gov/grants/funding-opportunities){target=_blank}

[National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)](https://www.noaa.gov/grants){target=_blank} - funding for ocean, coastal, and atmospheric research

### :fontawesome-solid-earth-americas: South America

**Chile:**

## :fontawesome-solid-earth-europe: Europe

## :material-bank: Foundations

[Alfred P. Sloan Foundation](https://sloan.org/){target=_blank} - supports research in science, technology, engineering, mathematics, and economics

[Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (CZI)](https://chanzuckerberg.com/science/programs-resources/open-science/){target=_blank} - supports open science including Essential Open Source Software for Science program (partnership with Kavli and Wellcome)

[Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation](https://www.moore.org/programs/science){target=_blank} - funds scientific discovery and environmental conservation research

[Kavli Foundation](https://www.kavlifoundation.org/){target=_blank} - supports fundamental research in astrophysics, nanoscience, neuroscience, and theoretical physics

[Wellcome Trust](https://wellcome.org/grant-funding){target=_blank} - UK-based global health research foundation supporting open science and open source software (partner in CZI-Kavli-Wellcome Essential Open Source Software initiative)

[Open Research Funders Group (ORFG)](https://www.orfg.org/){target=_blank} - consortium of funding organizations committed to open research practices

[John D. and Catherine T. MacArthur Foundation](https://www.macfound.org/){target=_blank} - supports creative people, effective institutions, and influential networks

[OceanKind](https://oceankind.org/){target=_blank} - supports ocean conservation and marine science research

[Research Corporation for Science Advancement](https://rescorp.org/){target=_blank} - private foundation advancing fundamental research in physics, chemistry, and astronomy

[Robert Wood Johnson Foundation](https://www.rwjf.org/en/how-we-work/grants-explorer/funding-opportunities.html){target=_blank} - largest philanthropy focused on health in the United States

[Simons Foundation](https://www.simonsfoundation.org/funding-opportunities/){target=_blank} - supports research in mathematics and the basic sciences

[Templeton World Charity Foundation](https://www.templetonworldcharity.org/){target=_blank} - funds research exploring big questions in science, philosophy, and theology

# Page: Data Management Plans
Section: Research
URL: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/dmp/
Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/dmp/index.md
Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/awesome-open-science/main/docs/dmp.md

## :material-directions-fork: Funding Agency Guidelines

### United States

[US National Science Foundation (NSF) Data](https://www.nsf.gov/data/){target=_blank} - comprehensive NSF data management resources

[US NSF Data Management Plan Requirements](https://www.nsf.gov/bfa/dias/policy/dmp.jsp){target=_blank} - official NSF DMP policy and requirements

[NIH Data Management & Sharing Policy](https://grants.nih.gov/policy-and-compliance/policy-topics/sharing-policies/dms){target=_blank} - effective January 2023, applies to all NIH-funded research

[NIH DMS Plan Elements](https://grants.nih.gov/policy-and-compliance/policy-topics/sharing-policies/dms/policy-overview){target=_blank} - six core elements required in NIH data management and sharing plans

[NASA Open Science and Data Management Plan](https://science.nasa.gov/researchers/sara/faqs/osdmp/){target=_blank} - ROSES OSDMP template and guidance for 2025/2026

[USGS Data Management Plans](https://www.usgs.gov/data-management/data-management-plans){target=_blank} - USGS policy and guidance

### International

[UKRI Data Management Plan Guidance](https://www.ukri.org/councils/stfc/guidance-for-applicants/what-to-include-in-your-proposal/data-management-plan/){target=_blank} - UK Research and Innovation DMP requirements

[UKRI MRC DMP Template](https://www.ukri.org/publications/data-management-plan-template/){target=_blank} - Medical Research Council template

[Canada Tri-Agency Research Data Management Policy](https://science.gc.ca/site/science/en/interagency-research-funding/policies-and-guidelines/research-data-management/tri-agency-research-data-management-policy){target=_blank} - CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC joint policy

[Canada DMP Assistant](https://assistant.portagenetwork.ca/){target=_blank} - national bilingual DMP tool supported by Digital Research Alliance of Canada

[European Commission Horizon Europe DMP](https://openscience.cuni.cz/OSCIEN-49.html){target=_blank} - Horizon Europe data management requirements

## :octicons-repo-template-24: DMP Tools & Templates

[:octicons-stack-24: DMP Tool](https://dmptool.org/){target=_blank} - free, community-supported service by UC Curation Center that creates machine-actionable DMPs meeting funder requirements and open science best practices. Includes 1000+ public sample plans.

[Data Stewardship Wizard](https://ds-wizard.org/){target=_blank} - publicly available web-based tool developed within ELIXIR infrastructure providing FAIR metrics and guiding users to make data as FAIR as possible

[DMPonline](https://dmponline.dcc.ac.uk/){target=_blank} - web-based tool by Digital Curation Centre (DCC) with pre-set templates based on specific funder policy documents

[Argos OpenAIRE](https://argos.openaire.eu/){target=_blank} - open source DMP tool developed within OpenAIRE and EUDAT projects, linked to ORCID, OpenAIRE services, and Zenodo repository

[Research Data Management Organiser (RDMO)](https://rdmorganiser.github.io/){target=_blank} - assemble all relevant planning information and data management tasks across the whole life cycle of research data

[OSF DMP Creation Guide](https://help.osf.io/article/144-creating-a-data-management-plan-dmp-document){target=_blank} - guidance for creating DMPs within Open Science Framework

## University & Institutional Guidance

[Harvard Data Management Plans](https://datamanagement.hms.harvard.edu/plan-design/data-management-and-sharing-plan){target=_blank} - HMS comprehensive DMP guidance and NIH DMSP templates

[MIT Data Management Plans](https://libraries.mit.edu/data-management/plan/write/){target=_blank} - MIT Libraries DMP writing guidance and templates

[Stanford DMP Services](https://library.stanford.edu/research/data-management-services){target=_blank} - Stanford Libraries data management planning support and DMPTool access

[UC Berkeley Research Data Management](https://researchdata.berkeley.edu/services/data-management-plans){target=_blank} - UC Berkeley consultations and DMP resources

[UArizona Data Management Plans](https://lib.arizona.edu/research/data/data-management/plans){target=_blank} - University of Arizona Libraries DMP guidance

[University of Michigan DMP Templates](https://guides.lib.umich.edu/c.php?g=283277&p=2138498){target=_blank} - comprehensive collection of DMP templates and examples

[UCSF Data Management Plans](https://guides.ucsf.edu/datamgmt/plans){target=_blank} - University of California San Francisco DMP resources

## DMP Best Practices & Training

[FAIR Data Principles](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/){target=_blank} - Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable principles for scientific data management

[TRUST Principles for Digital Repositories](https://www.rd-alliance.org/news/the-trust-principles-an-rda-community-effort/){target=_blank} - principles for digital repositories to be Transparent, Responsible, User-focused, Sustainable, and Technological

[Research Data Management Training](https://openscience.lib.cas.cz/en/open-fair-data/data-management/){target=_blank} - comprehensive RDM guidance from Czech Academy of Sciences

[NASA Earthdata DMP Guidance](https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/engage/data-management-guidance/create-maintain-open-science-data-management-plan){target=_blank} - creating and maintaining open science and data management plans for proposals

# Page: Data
Section: Data
URL: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/data/
Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/data/index.md
Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/awesome-open-science/main/docs/data.md

??? Tip "FAIR, CARE, & TRUST Principles"

    :material-magnify: :material-access-point: :fontawesome-solid-gears: :material-recycle: :octicons-people-24: :fontawesome-solid-building-columns: :fontawesome-solid-hands-holding-circle: :material-scale-balance:

    The FAIR acronym and principles were defined in a March 2016 paper in the journal Scientific Data by a consortium of scientists and organizations

    [Wilkinson et al. (2016)](https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2016.18){target=_blank} established the guidelines to improve the Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reuse (FAIR) of digital assets for research. 

    * [Go-FAIR website](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/){target=_blank} - official FAIR principles implementation guidance

    [Carroll et al. (2020)](http://doi.org/10.5334/dsj-2020-043){target=_blank} established the CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance.

    * [full document :fontawesome-solid-file-pdf:](https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5d3799de845604000199cd24/t/5da9f4479ecab221ce848fb2/1571419335217/CARE+Principles_One+Pagers+FINAL_Oct_17_2019.pdf){target=_blank} - one-page CARE principles summary
    * [US Indigenous Data Sovereignty Network](https://usindigenousdata.org/){target=_blank} - advancing Indigenous data governance and sovereignty

    [Lin et al. (2020)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0486-7){target=_blank} created the TRUST pinciples for digital repositories.

    * [TRUST Principles](https://www.rd-alliance.org/trust-principles-rda-community-effort){target=_blank} - digital repository transparency and sustainability principles 

## Data Use Agreements

[MIT model data use agreements](https://admindatahandbook.mit.edu/book/v1.0-rc4/dua.html){target=_blank} - templates for administrative data sharing agreements

[Databrary Access Agreement](https://databrary.org/about/agreement.html){target=_blank} - permits restricted access for data use and contribution by institutionally-authorized researchers who join [Databrary](https://databrary.org)

## Regulations

[European General Data Protection (GDPR)](https://gdpr-info.eu/){target=_blank} - EU data privacy and protection regulation

[US HIPAA](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/privacy/index.html){target=_blank} - health information privacy and security standards

## License Types

[Creative Commons Licenses](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/){target=_blank} - open content licenses for creative works

[Open Datacommons](https://opendatacommons.org/){target=_blank} - open licenses specifically for data and databases

[Open Source Initiative Licenses](https://opensource.org/licenses){target=_blank} - approved open source software licenses

## Accessibility

[W3 ARIA Suite](https://w3c.github.io/aria/){target=_blank} - Accessible Rich Internet Applications (ARIA)

[Web Accessibility Evaluation Tools List](https://www.w3.org/WAI/test-evaluate/tools/list/){target=_blank} - comprehensive list of web accessibility testing tools

[WAI-ARIA](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/aria/){target=_blank} - Web Accessibility Initiative ARIA standards and guidelines

[Mozilla ARIA](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA){target=_blank} - developer documentation for ARIA implementation

[NVDA](https://www.nvaccess.org/download/){target=_blank} - screen reading software

[JAWS](https://support.freedomscientific.com/Downloads/JAWS){target=_blank} - screen reading software

## Data Repositories

[Nature Scientific Data Repositories - Recommended](https://www.nature.com/sdata/policies/repositories){target=_blank} - metalist of data repositories recommended for Nature science articles

[Databrary](https://databrary.org){target=_blank} – NSF and NIH-funded repository specialized for storing and sharing video data and other identifiable data from human subjects research. Based at New York University.

[Dryad](https://datadryad.org){target=_blank} – started as US NSF project, used for data sets of any type that correspond to a research paper. 

[EBRAINS](https://ebrains.eu/){target=_blank} - European brain research infrastructure and data platform

[EUDAT](https://www.eudat.eu/){target=_blank} - network of European research organizations for data services

[European Data Portal](https://dataeuropa.gitlab.io/data-provider-manual/){target=_blank} - central access point for European open data

[Figshare](https://figshare.com/){target=_blank} - repository for research outputs in any format

[GitHub](https://github.com){target=_blank} - version control and code repository platform

[G-Node](https://www.g-node.org/) - German Neuroinformatics Node

[Harvard Dataverse](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/){target=_blank} – offers free storage of research data, owned by Harvard

[Merritt](https://merritt.cdlib.org/) - an open-source digital preservation repository maintained by the University of California Curation Center (UC3) at the California Digital Library (CDL).

[Mendeley Data](https://data.mendeley.com/){target=_blank} - free research data repository by Elsevier

[NITRC](https://www.nitrc.org/){target=_blank} - Neuroimaging Informatics Tools and Resources Collaboratory

[NeuroLibre](https://www.neurolibre.org/){target=_blank} - preprints for computational neuroscience with executable notebooks

[Open Access Directory](http://oad.simmons.edu/oadwiki/Data_repositories){target=_blank} - curated list of open data repositories

[OpenNeuro](https://openneuro.org/){target=_blank} - free platform for neuroimaging data sharing

[Open Science Framework](https://osf.io){target=_blank} - free platform for research workflow and collaboration

[PLOS Recommended Repositories](https://journals.plos.org/plosgenetics/s/recommended-repositories){target=_blank} - discipline-specific repositories recommended by PLOS journals

[PrePubMed](http://www.prepubmed.org/){target=_blank} - search engine for biomedical preprints and publications

[Registry of Research Data Repositories](https://www.re3data.org/){target=_blank} - global registry of research data repositories

[The Winnower (defunct)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Winnower){target=_blank} - platform is no longer active

[Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/){target=_blank} – EU-funded project by OpenAire, it is hosted by CERN. Useful for EU-funded projects because reports back to the EU research Participant Portal.

## Protocols and Bench Techniques

[BioProtocol](https://bio-protocol.org/Default.aspx){target=_blank} - peer-reviewed protocol journal for biological research

[Current Protocols](https://currentprotocols.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/){target=_blank} - step-by-step laboratory protocols across life sciences

[Gold Biotechnology Protocol list](https://www.goldbio.com/search?q=&type=documentation&documentation_type=protocol){target=_blank} - collection of molecular biology protocols and techniques

[JoVE](https://www.jove.com/){target=_blank} - Journal of Visualized Experiments with video protocols

[Nature Protocols](https://www.nature.com/nprot/){target=_blank} - peer-reviewed journal for research protocols

[OpenWetWare](https://openwetware.org/wiki/Main_Page){target=_blank} - wiki for sharing biology protocols and methods

[Protocol Exchange (archived, now part of protocols.io)](https://www.protocols.io/){target=_blank} - protocol sharing platform merged with protocols.io

[Protocols Online](http://www.protocol-online.org/prot/){target=_blank} - free collection of life science protocols

[:material-microscope: Protocols.io](https://www.protocols.io/){target=_blank} - largest open repository of scientific protocols

[SciGene](https://scigene.com/){target=_blank} - laboratory equipment manufacturer for cytogenetics

[Springer Nature Experiments](https://experiments.springernature.com/){target=_blank} - platform for publishing and discovering research methods

### Google Earth Engine Community Catalog

Includes atmospheric data, elevation models, land use/land cover, climate data, and specialized geoscience datasets not available in the official GEE catalog.

[NCAR/UCAR Data Archive](https://rda.ucar.edu/){target=_blank} - atmospheric and climate research data archive

[US National Phenology Network](https://www.usanpn.org/data){target=_blank} - plant and animal phenology observations

## Search Engines

[OSF Share](https://share.osf.io/sources){target=_blank} - search engine for open scholarly content

## Structured Data Search

[Schema.org](https://schema.org/){target=_blank} - structured data markup schemas for web content

[DataCommons.org](https://datacommons.org/){target=_blank} - Google's platform unifying public datasets

[Linked Open Data Cloud](https://lod-cloud.net/){target=_blank} - visualization of interconnected open datasets

## Scientific Knowledge Graphs

[AIDA Knowledge Graph](https://aida.kmi.open.ac.uk/){target=_blank} - 21M publications and 8M patents with CS topics

[Open Knowledge Graph](https://data.open.ac.uk/){target=_blank} - Open University's linked open data platform

[Open Research Knowledge Graph (ORKG)](https://orkg.org/){target=_blank} - structured scholarly knowledge with semantic descriptions

[Amazon Science Knowledge Graphs](https://www.amazon.science/tag/knowledge-graphs){target=_blank} - research publications on knowledge graph technology

## :material-search-web: Literature & Document Search

### Open Bibliographic Databases

[OpenAlex](https://openalex.org/){target=_blank} - free and open catalog of the global research system with 250M+ works, successor to Microsoft Academic Graph

[The Lens](https://www.lens.org/){target=_blank} - free, open scholarly search and analytics platform with patent data integration

[Dimensions](https://www.dimensions.ai/){target=_blank} - research intelligence platform linking publications, grants, patents, clinical trials (free basic access)

### General Search Engines

[:material-google: Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/intl/en/scholar/about.html){target=_blank} - based on Google's powerful knowledge graph

[Bielefeld Academic Search Engine (BASE)](https://www.base-search.net/){target=_blank} - provides more than 240 million documents from more than 8,000 content providers

[BioOne](https://bioone.org/){target=_blank} - aggregator of bioscience research journals

[CERN Document Server](https://cds.cern.ch/?ln=en){target=_blank} - CERN's repository for physics publications

[CiteSeerX](http://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/index){target=_blank} - digital library for computer science literature

[CORE](https://core.ac.uk/){target=_blank} - 207M+ open access articles from 10,000+ providers

[DeepDive](http://deepdive.stanford.edu/){target=_blank} - Stanford's knowledge extraction system

- [PaleoDeepDive](http://deepdive.stanford.edu/paleo){target=_blank} - paleobiology literature mining

- [GeoDeepDive (xDD)](https://xdd.wisc.edu/){target=_blank} - geoscience digital library and knowledge extraction

[Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ)](https://doaj.org/){target=_blank} - 20,000+ peer-reviewed open access journals

[Mendeley](https://www.elsevier.com/solutions/mendeley){target=_blank} - reference manager and academic social network

[Microsoft Academic](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/project/academic/){target=_blank} - Microsoft's academic search engine (discontinued 2021)

[Organic ePrints](https://orgprints.org/){target=_blank} - open access archive for organic agriculture

[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/){target=_blank} - biomedical literature database with 35M+ citations

[ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/){target=_blank} - academic social network for sharing papers

[Science.gov](https://www.science.gov/){target=_blank} - US government science information portal

[ScienceDirect](https://www.sciencedirect.com/){target=_blank} - Elsevier's full-text scientific database

[ScienceOpen](https://www.scienceopen.com/){target=_blank} - open research and publishing network

[Scopus](https://www.scopus.com/home.uri){target=_blank} - Elsevier's citation database covering 27,000+ journals

[Semantic Scholar](https://www.semanticscholar.org/){target=_blank} - AI-powered research literature search

[SSRN](https://www.ssrn.com/index.cfm/en/){target=_blank} - Social Science Research Network preprint repository

[UpToDate](https://www.uptodate.com/contents/search){target=_blank} - evidence-based clinical decision support

## :material-file-document-multiple: Preprint Servers

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/){target=_blank} - pioneering preprint server for physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, and statistics (since 1991)

[bioRxiv](https://www.biorxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint server for biology operated by openRxiv nonprofit (founded 2013)

[medRxiv](https://www.medrxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint server for health sciences operated by openRxiv nonprofit (founded 2019)

[ChemRxiv](https://chemrxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint server for chemistry hosted by American Chemical Society

[EarthArXiv](https://eartharxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint service for Earth science research

[PsyArXiv](https://psyarxiv.com/){target=_blank} - preprint archive for psychological science

[SocArXiv](https://osf.io/preprints/socarxiv){target=_blank} - open archive of social science research

[engrXiv](https://engrxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint server for engineering

[AgriXiv](https://agrirxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint service for agriculture and allied sciences

[RePEc](https://repec.org/){target=_blank} - Research Papers in Economics, collaborative effort of hundreds of volunteers

## Query Languages

[Web Ontology Language (OWL)](https://www.w3.org/OWL/){target=_blank} - W3C semantic web ontology language

[Resource Description Framework (RDF)](https://www.w3.org/RDF/){target=_blank} - W3C standard for representing linked data

[SPARQL](https://www.w3.org/TR/rdf-sparql-query/){target=_blank} - query language for RDF databases

[GeoSPARQL](https://www.ogc.org/standards/geosparql){target=_blank} - geographic extension to SPARQL query language

# Page: Publishing
Section: Open Access
URL: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/publishing/
Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/publishing/index.md
Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/awesome-open-science/main/docs/publishing.md

## Pre-Print Servers

### Multidisciplinary

[ASAPbio Pre-Print Server List](https://asapbio.org/preprint-servers){target=_blank} - comprehensive directory of preprint servers maintained by ASAPbio, a scientist-driven non-profit promoting transparency in life science communication.

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/){target=_blank} - free distribution service and open-access archive for 2.4+ million scholarly articles in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, electrical engineering and systems science, and economics.

[OSF.io Preprints](https://osf.io/preprints/){target=_blank} - multidisciplinary preprint platform operated by Center for Open Science with support for multiple domains.

[Preprints.org](https://www.preprints.org/){target=_blank} - free multidisciplinary preprint server supported by MDPI covering all scientific disciplines.

[Research Square](https://www.researchsquare.com/){target=_blank} - preprint platform integrated with major publishers for rapid sharing before peer review.

### Life & Health Sciences

[BioRxiv](https://www.biorxiv.org/){target=_blank} - open access preprint repository for biological sciences, now operated by openRxiv (launched 2025).

[medRxiv](https://www.medrxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint server for health sciences, now operated by openRxiv alongside bioRxiv.

[EcoEvoRxiv](https://www.ecoevorxiv.com/){target=_blank} - preprint server for ecology, evolution, and conservation science.

### Physical Sciences & Engineering

[ChemRxiv](https://chemrxiv.org/){target=_blank} - preprint server for chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, and related disciplines.

[engrXiv](https://engrxiv.org/){target=_blank} - open preprint server for engineering covering chemical, civil, environmental, materials, mechanical, and other engineering fields.

[TechRxiv](https://www.techrxiv.org/){target=_blank} - IEEE-affiliated preprint server for electrical engineering, computer science, and technology research.

### Earth & Space Sciences

[ESSOar](https://www.essoar.org/){target=_blank} - Earth and Space Science Open Archive hosted by the American Geophysical Union.

### Social Sciences & Humanities

[SocArXiv](https://osf.io/preprints/socarxiv){target=_blank} - open archive for social science research across all disciplines.

[MetaArXiv](https://osf.io/preprints/metaarxiv){target=_blank} - preprint server focused on research transparency, reproducibility, and meta-science.

### Regional Preprint Servers

[AfricArXiv](https://info.africarxiv.org/){target=_blank} - pan-African open access preprint repository for research about Africa or by African scientists, established 2018.

[IndiaRxiv](https://indiarxiv.org/){target=_blank} - India's first preprint server for domestic research across all disciplines, relaunched 2024.

## Financial Support for Open Access Publishing Fees

### National & Regional Programs

[HINARI](http://www.emro.who.int/information-resources/hinari/){target=_blank} - WHO program providing free or low-cost journal access to low- and middle-income countries.

[Max Planck Digital Library](https://group.springernature.com/gb/group/media/press-releases/landmark-agreement-between-springer-nature-and-mpdl/18498782){target=_blank} - transformative agreement enabling German authors to publish open access in Springer Nature journals without APC fees.

[Bibsam Consortium](https://www.springernature.com/gp/open-research/institutional-agreements/oaforsweden){target=_blank} - Swedish consortium agreement covering open access fees in Springer Nature research journals.

[PALCI ACS Agreement](https://www.psu.edu/news/university-libraries/story/scientific-publisher-agreements-expand-open-access-research){target=_blank} - Partnership for Academic Library Collaboration & Innovation agreement eliminating author publishing charges for ACS journals (through 2026+).

### University Library OA Funds

[MIT Libraries OA Publishing Support](https://libraries.mit.edu/scholarly/publishing/oa-publishing-support/){target=_blank} - MIT agreements with PLOS, Taylor & Francis, and other publishers providing no-cost OA publishing for MIT authors through 2026.

[Open Access Publishing Fund - Florida State](https://www.lib.fsu.edu/research-and-publish/publishing/open-access-funding){target=_blank} - financial support for Article Processing Charges at FSU.

[Indiana University Open Access Fund](https://research.iu.edu/funding-proposals/funding/opportunities/open-access-journal-fund/index.html){target=_blank} - IU program supporting APC costs for fully open access journals.

[Tufts Tisch Library OA Fund](https://tischlibrary.tufts.edu/about-library/library-awards/tisch-library-open-access-publishing-fund){target=_blank} - up to $30,000 available for 2025-2026 academic year for open access publishing.

### International Funding

[Horizon Europe Open Research Europe](https://open-research-europe.ec.europa.eu/){target=_blank} - European Commission's no-cost open access publishing service for Horizon Europe grant beneficiaries.

[SciDev.Net](https://www.scidev.net/global/){target=_blank} - science and development news network supporting open access in developing countries.

## Open Access Publishing

### Open Access Directories & Indexes

[Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ)](https://doaj.org/){target=_blank} - curated directory of 22,464+ peer-reviewed open access journals from 140 countries with 12+ million article records; 14,024 journals charge no fees.

[SciELO](https://scielo.org/){target=_blank} - Scientific Electronic Library Online covering 16 countries across Latin America, Caribbean, South Africa, Spain, and Portugal; pioneering regional diamond open access since 1997.

[Redalyc](https://www.redalyc.org/){target=_blank} - Red de Revistas Científicas de América Latina y el Caribe indexing 1,500+ diamond open access journals with 750,000+ articles from 25 countries.

### Diamond Open Access Publishers

Diamond (or platinum) open access means no fees for readers OR authors - 100% free publishing and access.

[MIT Press Direct to Open (D2O)](https://mitpress.mit.edu/mit-press-expands-direct-to-open-d2o-open-access-model-in-2026-with-publishing-partners/){target=_blank} - diamond open access model for scholarly monographs, expanding in 2026 with Duke University Press and Goldsmiths Press.

[Beilstein Journals](https://www.beilstein-journals.org/){target=_blank} - diamond open access journals in chemistry and nanotechnology, fully funded by the Beilstein-Institut foundation in Germany.

[Diamond Scientific Publishing](https://www.diamondopen.com/){target=_blank} - international publisher of diamond open access books, journals, and conference proceedings across multiple fields.

[Emerald Diamond OA Journals](https://www.emeraldgrouppublishing.com/publish-with-us/open-research-emerald/diamond-open-access-journals){target=_blank} - diamond open access journals published in partnership with universities and associations.

[Cambridge Diamond](https://diamond-oa.lib.cam.ac.uk/){target=_blank} - University of Cambridge's platform supporting diamond open access publishing initiatives.

### Major Open Access Publishers

[PLOS (Public Library of Science)](https://plos.org/){target=_blank} - pioneering nonprofit open access publisher founded 2000, publishing seven peer-reviewed journals across all sciences.

[MDPI](https://www.mdpi.com/){target=_blank} - Swiss publisher of 400+ open access journals across sciences, technology, and medicine; many institutions offer 10% APC discounts.

[Frontiers](https://www.frontiersin.org/){target=_blank} - open access publisher with journals across sciences, technology, medicine, and humanities using collaborative peer review.

[F1000Research](https://f1000research.com/){target=_blank} - innovative open access platform with rapid publication, open peer review, and support for data sharing across biomedical, life, and physical sciences.

[PeerJ](https://peerj.com/){target=_blank} - open access publisher of seven journals in biomedical, life, environmental, physical, and computer sciences with affordable APCs.

[eLife](https://elifesciences.org/){target=_blank} - nonprofit open access journal for biomedical and life sciences, known for innovative peer review and the Sciety preprint review platform.

[Copernicus Publications](https://publications.copernicus.org/){target=_blank} - largest open access publisher in geo- and Earth system sciences since 2001, pioneering interactive open peer review.

### Traditional Publishers with OA Options

[AAAS Science Open Access](https://www.science.org/content/page/open-access-aaas){target=_blank} - American Association for Advancement of Science open access publishing in Science family journals.

[Nature Portfolio Open Access](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/open-access){target=_blank} - Springer Nature's 600+ open access journals plus OA options in hybrid journals.

[American Geophysical Union (AGU)](https://www.agu.org/Publish-with-AGU/Publish/Open-Access){target=_blank} - Earth and space sciences open access publishing across 20+ journals.

[CSIRO Publishing](https://www.publish.csiro.au/){target=_blank} - Australian research organization's open access options across environmental, agricultural, and physical sciences.

# Page: Cyberinfrastructure
Section: Cyberinfrastructure
URL: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/cyberinfrastructure/
Markdown twin: https://tyson-swetnam.github.io/awesome-open-science/cyberinfrastructure/index.md
Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tyson-swetnam/awesome-open-science/main/docs/cyberinfrastructure.md

# Cyberinfrastructure

## :material-server-network: US National Supercomputing & HPC

### ACCESS (Advanced Cyberinfrastructure Coordination Ecosystem: Services & Support)

[ACCESS](https://access-ci.org/){target=_blank} - NSF-funded cyberinfrastructure ecosystem providing researchers with access to advanced computing resources

[ACCESS Anvil](https://www.rcac.purdue.edu/anvil){target=_blank} - Purdue University's composable system with 84 H100 GPUs added for NAIRR initiatives

[ACCESS Bridges-2](https://www.psc.edu/resources/bridges-2/){target=_blank} - Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center's heterogeneous architecture with extreme memory nodes

[ACCESS Delta](https://www.ncsa.illinois.edu/resources-and-services/compute-resources/delta/){target=_blank} - NCSA's GPU-focused system, "most performant GPU resource in NSF portfolio" with 5.16 petaflops

[ACCESS Expanse](https://www.sdsc.edu/systems/expanse/user_guide.html){target=_blank} - San Diego Supercomputer Center's 5.16 petaflops system with Kubernetes subsystem

[ACCESS Frontera](https://tacc.utexas.edu/systems/frontera/){target=_blank} - TACC's fastest US academic supercomputer, $60M NSF investment

[Horizon Supercomputer](https://tacc.utexas.edu/systems/horizon/){target=_blank} - TACC's upcoming $457M system at LCCF, 10× Frontera performance expected 2026

[Jetstream2](https://jetstream-cloud.org/){target=_blank} - NSF-funded cloud computing resource with 8 petaFLOPS for science and engineering research

## :material-earth: International HPC & Supercomputers

[ARCHER2](https://www.archer2.ac.uk/){target=_blank} - UK's 28 PFLOP/s national supercomputing service

[EuroHPC Joint Undertaking](https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/){target=_blank} - European initiative with 11+ supercomputers including JUPITER exascale system

[IDRIS Jean Zay](http://www.idris.fr/eng/){target=_blank} - France's 125.9 PFLOPS AI-focused system with 1456 H100 GPUs (Jean Zay supercomputer)

[Snellius](https://www.surf.nl/en/services/compute/snellius-the-national-supercomputer){target=_blank} - Netherlands national 14 petaflops supercomputer operated by SURF

## :material-cloud-outline: Cloud & Distributed Infrastructure

### Research Cloud Platforms

[Chameleon Cloud](https://www.chameleoncloud.org/){target=_blank} - NSF-funded cloud research testbed, Phase 4 with $12M funding through 2028

[CloudLab](https://www.cloudlab.us/){target=_blank} - NSF-funded cloud research infrastructure with 1000+ machines for experimental cloud computing

[CloudBank](https://www.cloudbank.org/){target=_blank} - NSF-funded cloud access program, CloudBank 2.0 launched April 2025 with $20M

[NIH STRIDES](https://cloud.nih.gov/){target=_blank} - NIH Strategic Partnerships providing AWS, Google, Azure access with enterprise support

### Commercial Cloud Research Credits

[AWS Cloud Credit for Research](https://aws.amazon.com/government-education/research-and-technical-computing/cloud-credit-for-research/){target=_blank} - Amazon Web Services research credit program

[Google Cloud Research Credits](https://cloud.google.com/edu/researchers){target=_blank} - Google Cloud Platform credits for academic researchers

[Microsoft Azure Research Credits](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/azure-academic-research/){target=_blank} - Azure credits for academic research projects

### Commercial Cloud Education Programs

[AWS Cloud for Education](https://aws.amazon.com/education/){target=_blank} - Amazon educational programs and credits

[Google Cloud for Education](https://edu.google.com/){target=_blank} - Google Cloud education programs

[Microsoft Azure for Education](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/community/education){target=_blank} - Azure for students and educators

[GitHub Education](https://education.github.com/){target=_blank} - GitHub student developer pack with free Codespaces hours

[DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/){target=_blank} - commercial cloud platform with education and research programs

### Open Source Cloud Software

[OpenStack](https://www.openstack.org/){target=_blank} - most widely deployed open source cloud software in the world, powers many research clouds

## :material-kubernetes: Federated Kubernetes & Distributed Computing

[National Research Platform (NRP)](https://nrp.ai/){target=_blank} - formerly Pacific Research Platform, multi-institutional deployment with 1400+ GPUs

- [Prototype National Research Platform](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/show-award/?AWD_ID=2112167&HistoricalAwards=false){target=_blank} - NSF-funded next stage deployment across US
- [Nautilus](https://nrp.ai/){target=_blank} - the NRP Kubernetes portal and computing platform

[2i2c](https://2i2c.org/){target=_blank} - designs, develops, and operates JupyterHubs in the cloud for 90+ research & education communities (7000+ users)

### High Throughput Computing

[Open Science Grid (OSG)](https://osg-htc.org/){target=_blank} - consortium dedicated to distributed High Throughput Computing (dHTC) for open science

[PATh (Partnership to Advance Throughput Computing)](https://path-cc.io/){target=_blank} - $22.5M NSF project for throughput computing, includes OSG

## :material-flask-outline: Cloud Workbenches & Science Platforms

### Multi-Domain Platforms

[CyVerse Discovery Environment](https://de.cyverse.org/){target=_blank} - multi-platform service for full-stack cloud data management (⚠️ NSF funding ended 2024, subscription model Jan 2025)

[Open Science Framework (OSF)](https://osf.io/){target=_blank} - free, open platform connecting and supporting the research workflow

[WholeTale](https://wholetale.org/){target=_blank} - NSF-funded platform for creating, sharing, and reproducing computational research

### Biomedical & Life Sciences

[Galaxy](https://galaxyproject.org/){target=_blank} - scientific workflow platform for biomedical research with 500K+ users

[KBase](https://www.kbase.us/){target=_blank} - DOE Systems Biology Knowledgebase for predictive biology

[Terra.bio](https://terra.bio/){target=_blank} - genomics data platform with 80 PB storage and 65K+ users on GCP/Azure

[DNAnexus](https://www.dnanexus.com/){target=_blank} - cloud-based platform for DNA sequence data analysis and management

[Gen3](https://gen3.org/){target=_blank} - NIH data commons framework for managing, analyzing, and sharing research data

[ELIXIR Compute Platform](https://elixir-europe.org/platforms/compute){target=_blank} - European life sciences infrastructure for computational workflows

### Geospatial & Earth Science

[CyberGIS](https://cybergis.illinois.edu/){target=_blank} - NSF-funded HPC and cloud service for geospatial data analyses

[Google Earth Engine (GEE)](https://earthengine.google.com/){target=_blank} - petabyte-scale platform for Earth science data & analysis

[Microsoft Planetary Computer](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/){target=_blank} - Azure compute environment with multi-petabyte catalog of Earth observation data (Pro version launched May 2025)

[Open Data Cube](https://www.opendatacube.org/){target=_blank} - open-source platform for Earth observation data with monthly releases

[OpenEO Cloud](https://openeo.cloud/){target=_blank} - cloud platform for large-scale Earth observation data processing

[PANGEO](https://pangeo.io/){target=_blank} - community platform for big data geoscience

[Copernicus Climate Data Store](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/){target=_blank} - European C3S climate toolbox infrastructure

[Euro Data Cube](https://eurodatacube.com/){target=_blank} - Earth observation data platform for European Sentinel data

[Sentinel Hub](https://www.sentinel-hub.com/){target=_blank} - satellite imagery platform (acquired by Planet Labs August 2023)

[Climate Toolbox](https://climatetoolbox.org/){target=_blank} - US-focused tool for accessing North America climate data

[SciMAAP](https://scimaap.net/){target=_blank} - NASA/ESA Multi-Mission Algorithm and Analysis Platform

### Engineering & Natural Hazards

[DesignSafe-CI](https://www.designsafe-ci.org/){target=_blank} - comprehensive cyberinfrastructure for natural hazards engineering research

### Water Resources

[HydroShare](https://www.hydroshare.org/){target=_blank} - CUAHSI-supported platform for hydrological science applications and data sharing

### Materials Science

[Materials Cloud](https://www.materialscloud.org/){target=_blank} - platform for computational materials science with AiiDA provenance tracking

[Materials Project](https://materialsproject.org/){target=_blank} - materials database serving 600K+ researchers with pymatgen API

[NOMAD](https://nomad-lab.eu/nomad-lab/){target=_blank} - materials database with 19.2M+ entries and AI Toolkit

### Ocean & Marine Science

[Ocean Observatories Initiative (OOI)](https://oceanobservatories.org/){target=_blank} - NSF ocean sensor network infrastructure for sustained ocean observations

[SeaDataNet](https://www.seadatanet.org/){target=_blank} - pan-European marine data infrastructure with 110+ data centers

### Agriculture

[GEMS Informatics Platform](https://gems.umn.edu/){target=_blank} - University of Minnesota agri-food data and computational platform

## :material-robot-outline: AI & Specialized Computing

[NAIRR Pilot](https://nairrpilot.org/){target=_blank} - National AI Research Resource pilot launched January 2024 with 150+ resource awards

[NDIF (National Deep Inference Facility)](https://ndif.us/){target=_blank} - $9M NSF facility for large language model interpretability research

[DeltaAI](https://www.ncsa.illinois.edu/resources-and-services/compute-resources/deltaai/){target=_blank} - NCSA's NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper system supporting NAIRR/NDIF

[ICICLE (Intelligent CyberInfrastructure with Computational Learning in the Environment)](https://icicle.osu.edu/){target=_blank} - NSF AI Institute with $20M funding through 2026

[FutureHouse Platform](https://www.futurehouse.org/){target=_blank} - AI research agents for scientific discovery (launched May 2024)

## :material-transfer: Data Transfer & Management Services

[Globus](https://www.globus.org/){target=_blank} - research data management platform serving 170K+ researchers for secure, reliable data transfer

## :material-code-tags: Development Environments & Notebooks

### Cloud Development Environments

[Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/){target=_blank} - free Jupyter notebooks with GPU access, AI-first with Gemini integration (September 2025)

[GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces){target=_blank} - cloud-based VS Code instances from GitHub repositories (120 free core-hours monthly)

[MyBinder.org](https://mybinder.org/){target=_blank} - free reproducible computing environments from GitHub repositories (RStudio, Jupyter, VS Code)

[GitPod](https://www.gitpod.io/){target=_blank} - automated dev environments in the cloud

### Development Tools

[Posit](https://posit.co/){target=_blank} - formerly RStudio, rebranded July 2022 for multi-language data science (R, Python, VS Code)

## :material-database-outline: Data Repositories & Infrastructure

[Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/){target=_blank} - CERN-hosted open data repository with 50GB per upload limit

[InvenioRDM](https://inveniosoftware.org/products/rdm/){target=_blank} - repository software powering Zenodo (v13.0 released July 2025)

[OpenAIRE](https://www.openaire.eu/){target=_blank} - European open science infrastructure with 100M+ publications and datasets

## :material-flag-variant: European Research Infrastructure

[European Open Science Cloud (EOSC)](https://eosc-portal.eu/){target=_blank} - EU initiative for federated open science infrastructure and services

[EOSC EU Node](https://open-science-cloud.ec.europa.eu/){target=_blank} - first European federation node launched 2024

[EGI Federation](https://www.egi.eu/){target=_blank} - European Grid Infrastructure providing advanced computing services for EOSC

[EUDAT](https://eudat.eu/){target=_blank} - European data infrastructure with B2DROP, B2SHARE, B2SAFE services

[D4Science](https://www.d4science.org/){target=_blank} - European e-Infrastructure platform for collaborative research

## :material-flag: Regional Research Infrastructure

### Canada

[Compute Canada](https://computecanada.ca/){target=_blank} - national advanced research computing platform (transitioning to Digital Research Alliance)

[Digital Research Alliance of Canada](https://alliancecan.ca/){target=_blank} - national organization providing research computing, data management, and software services

[Federated Research Data Repository (FRDR)](https://www.frdr-dfdr.ca/repo/){target=_blank} - bilingual national data repository for Canadian researchers

### Australia & New Zealand

[AARNet](https://www.aarnet.edu.au/){target=_blank} - Australia's Academic and Research Network providing high-speed connectivity and cloud services

[New Zealand eScience Infrastructure (NeSI)](https://www.nesi.org.nz/){target=_blank} - national computing infrastructure for New Zealand researchers

### South Africa

[National Integrated Cyberinfrastructure System (NICIS)](https://www.chpc.ac.za/){target=_blank} - South Africa's Centre for High Performance Computing (note: nicis.ac.za has SSL issues, using CHPC alternate URL)

## :material-history: Ended or Transitioned Services

⚠️ **XSEDE (Extreme Science and Engineering Discovery Environment)** - US NSF advanced cyberinfrastructure program ended in 2022, replaced by ACCESS (Advanced Cyberinfrastructure Coordination Ecosystem)

⚠️ **National Data Service (NDS) Labs** - experimental space for research data management services (inactive since 2018)

⚠️ **National Data Service (NDS) Labs** - experimental space for research data management services (inactive since 2018)

⚠️ **ABoVE (Arctic-Boreal Vulnerability Experiment)** - NASA Arctic-Boreal campaign completed May 2025

⚠️ **Data8 edX Course** - UC Berkeley's data science MOOC on hiatus, but Berkeley course continues

ℹ️ **Seven Bridges** - merged into Velsera January 2023, Seven Bridges brand continues

!!! Quote "Defining Openness"

    "Open means anyone can freely access, use, modify, and share for any purpose (subject, at most, to requirements that preserve provenance and openness)." - [The Open Definition](https://opendefinition.org/){target=_blank}

## Licenses

[:material-creative-commons: Creative Commons Licenses](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/){target=_blank}

## :material-flask: Scientific Support Systems

[Center for Open Science](https://www.cos.io/){target=_blank} - nonprofit improving openness, integrity, and reproducibility of research

- [Open Science Framework (OSF)](https://osf.io/){target=_blank} - free, open platform to support research workflow and collaboration

[Digital Object Identifier (DOI) Org](https://www.doi.org/){target=_blank} - is the registration authority for the ISO standard (ISO 26324) for the DOI system. The DOI system provides a technical and social infrastructure for the registration and use of persistent interoperable identifiers, called DOIs, for use on digital networks

[:fontawesome-brands-orcid: ORCID](https://orcid.org/){target=_blank} - unique digital ID for every researcher

[ROR (Research Organization Registry)](https://ror.org/){target=_blank} - community-led registry of open, sustainable, usable identifiers for research organizations

[Crossref](https://www.crossref.org/){target=_blank} - official DOI registration agency for scholarly metadata

[DataCite](https://datacite.org/){target=_blank} - global DOI registration agency for research data and other research outputs

[Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/){target=_blank} - EU funded project for DOIs, hosts open datasets and software

[Zotero](https://www.zotero.org/){target=_blank} - open source publication and citation manager

[Mendeley](https://www.mendeley.com/){target=_blank} - reference manager and academic social network

[Protocols.io](https://www.protocols.io/){target=_blank} - open access repository of science methods and research protocols

[Bango](https://github.com/Bilal-S/Bango/blob/main/README.md){target=_blank} - open source AI-powered desktop app for systematic literature review screening, search, bibliometric analysis, and PRISMA 2020 diagrams; local-first and privacy-preserving

## :material-code-tags: Scientific Programming Languages

### Compiled Languages

[:material-language-c: C](https://www.iso.org/standard/74528.html){target=_blank} - general-purpose computer programming language, foundational for systems programming

[C++](https://isocpp.org/){target=_blank} - general-purpose programming language with object-oriented features

[:material-language-csharp: C#](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/){target=_blank} - general-purpose, multi-paradigm programming language by Microsoft

[:material-language-fortran: Fortran](https://fortran-lang.org/){target=_blank} - designed from the ground up for computationally intensive applications in science and engineering

- [LFortran](https://lfortran.org/){target=_blank} - modern open-source interactive Fortran compiler built on LLVM, supports multi-core CPUs and GPUs

[:fontawesome-brands-golang: Go](https://go.dev/){target=_blank} - open source programming language by Google, excellent for concurrent systems

[:material-language-rust: Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/){target=_blank} - blazingly fast and memory-efficient systems language with no garbage collector, increasingly popular in scientific computing

[Swift](https://www.swift.org/){target=_blank} - powerful open-source language by Apple, used for machine learning (Swift for TensorFlow)

[Zig](https://ziglang.org/){target=_blank} - general-purpose systems programming language emphasizing robustness and maintainability

### Scripting & Interpreted Languages

[:material-bash: BASH](https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/){target=_blank} - GNU Project's shell, the Bourne Again SHell

[:octicons-terminal-24: UNIX Shell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_shell){target=_blank} - command-line interpreter for Unix-like systems

[Julia](https://julialang.org/){target=_blank} - high-level, high-performance dynamic language for technical computing

[MATLAB](https://www.mathworks.com/products/matlab.html){target=_blank} - proprietary multi-paradigm programming language for numerical computing (see GNU Octave for open alternative)

[GNU Octave](https://octave.org/){target=_blank} - free, open-source alternative to MATLAB for numerical computations

[PERL](https://www.perl.org/){target=_blank} - high-level, general-purpose, interpreted dynamic programming language

[:material-language-python: Python](https://www.python.org/){target=_blank} - high-level, interpreted, general-purpose programming language, dominant in scientific computing

[:material-language-r: R](https://www.r-project.org/){target=_blank} - programming language for statistical computing and graphics

[Scala](https://www.scala-lang.org/){target=_blank} - functional and object-oriented language, runs on JVM, used in big data (Apache Spark)

[TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/){target=_blank} - strongly typed programming language built on JavaScript

### Web & Markup Languages

[:material-language-html5: HTML](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/){target=_blank} - markup language for structuring content on the World Wide Web

[:material-language-javascript: JavaScript](https://www.javascript.com/){target=_blank} - programming language of the Web

[:material-code-json: JSON](https://www.json.org/json-en.html){target=_blank} - JavaScript Object Notation, lightweight data-interchange format

[GeoJSON](https://geojson.org/){target=_blank} - JSON extension for geospatial data

[YAML](https://yaml.org/){target=_blank} - "YAML Ain't Markup Language" used in application configurations

[TOML](https://toml.io/){target=_blank} - Tom's Obvious, Minimal Language for configuration files

### Build Tools

[Make](https://www.gnu.org/software/make/){target=_blank} - build automation tool using Makefiles

[CMake](https://cmake.org/){target=_blank} - open-source, cross-platform family of tools to build, test and package software

[Meson](https://mesonbuild.com/){target=_blank} - open source build system designed for speed and usability

[Bazel](https://bazel.build/){target=_blank} - fast, scalable, multi-language build system by Google

### Lightweight Markup Languages

[Lightweight Markup Languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lightweight_markup_language){target=_blank} are designed to be human readable with minimal syntax

[:material-language-markdown: Markdown](https://daringfireball.net/projects/markdown/){target=_blank} - lightweight markup language for creating formatted text using plain-text editor

[ReStructuredText (RST)](https://docutils.sourceforge.io/rst.html){target=_blank} - file format for textual data used primarily in Python for technical documentation

[AsciiDoc](https://asciidoc.org/){target=_blank} - text document format for writing notes, documentation, articles, books
